topic: Data pipeline updates and data export clarification
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the status of several data pipelines, including 'recalc' and 'upload only'. [me] proposed running a job on a dedicated machine in the cluster (e.g., 96 or 128 GB) to handle jobs and data processing, potentially aligning with an ARM transition for cost efficiency.

[p1] confirmed launching existing jobs ('agg' and 'upload only') as requested by [me].

Regarding data exports, a specific question arose about whether the required export date should be based on the day of the month or the week. [p1] noted that someone (Esben) had provided guidance, but confirmed they would follow up with him the next day to clarify the requirement.
decisions: A dedicated machine in the cluster will be used for running data jobs and processing.
action_items: [me] will investigate the complexities of the data export date requirement (day of month vs. week).
[p1] will follow up with Esben regarding the required frequency/basis for the data export.
